_comment: NOVA autonomy boundary. Protective reversible actions may be autonomous; irreversible or security/financial actions remain human-gated until explicit evidence changes this policy.

autonomy_levels.L1_ANALYZE: Read, compare, benchmark, simulate, and reason.
autonomy_levels.L2_REVERSIBLE_PROTECT: Routing, retry, failover, demotion, alerts, candidate creation.
autonomy_levels.L3_CONTROLLED_CHANGE: Tested change in protected branch or equivalent controlled boundary.
autonomy_levels.L4_HIGH_IMPACT: Production/security/payment changes require stronger explicit authorization.
